description: Four units of a stereo core frame and an extension substream with a lossless 5.1 asset whose headers never state the static fields, so the stream has the core's two channels.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's decoder does not decode the lossless extension without the asset's static fields, so ffprobe names the core's profile (DTS) and its two channels
skip.decode_alone: a unit whose header omits the static fields is rejected by ffmpeg when decoded alone; the whole file decodes without an error
